tagline: after-hours sound · selections · a wall of records
source: derived from design-brief-raw.json (PIL analysis of 21 Instagram images)
direction: Moody after-hours club aesthetic. Near-black wine base (#0b0607) lifted by off-white type. A single vivid-red accent (#e2231a) carries energy, with electric blue (#3b6ef0) as a secondary signal pulled from his blue-toned shots. Warm beige highlights (#e7e3dd) nod to analog/film grain. Heavy condensed display type, lots of negative space, sharp 1px hairlines. The Wall section bleeds his actual feed imagery so the page IS his visual language.
